{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders in completed (they were all refunded or not completed)
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
print("QA orders in completed:", (qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')).sum())

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
